messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: severity=P2 - routing surge + fallback misroute detected. Observed spike in requests from EU customers between ~1978001100-1978001300. Symptoms: elevated p50/p95, increased cross-region routing to eu-central-1, fallback model selection to redwood-lite-v1. Affected: 3 tenant orgs (partial degradations). Pager details -> https://internal.ops/routing/alerts/1978001111 :rotating_light:

maria-nguyen: oncall here, acknowledging. Starting triage. tagging @jay-khan for routing config and @leo for model compatibility check.

jay-khan: looking now. quick snapshot from routing-proxy: high spill ratio from eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 after capacity watermark hit 0.85. I can grab the recent route decision log.

leo: I'll verify model compatibility on the fallback. If redwood-lite-v1 was chosen and it's missing a token-type mapping we could see transformation errors or higher latency.

rachel-ops: copying initial logs I pulled from the routing node (trimmed):
```
[1978001112] ROUTE_DECISION: req_id=ab12 model=redwood-large-v2 target_region=eu-west-1 result=spillover->eu-central-1 reason=capacity_watermark>=0.85 fallback_model=redwood-lite-v1
[1978001112] FWD: routed_to=eu-central-1 latency_ms=3100 status=200
[1978001113] ROUTE_DECISION: req_id=cd34 model=redwood-large-v2 target_region=eu-west-1 result=spillover->eu-central-1 reason=capacity_watermark>=0.85 fallback_model=redwood-lite-v1
[1978001113] FWD: routed_to=eu-central-1 latency_ms=5200 status=504
[1978001114] ROUTE_DECISION: req_id=ef56 model=redwood-large-v2 target_region=eu-west-1 result=local->serve reason=cache_hit
```

maria-nguyen: initial customer-impact quick assessment: 3 tenants saw >2s p95. 1 tenant had an elevated 5xx rate (~3% of requests during window). Prioritize contacting that CSM after mitigation.

jay-khan: hypothesizing two things: (1) capacity watermark config for eu-west-1 was accidentally lowered in the last deploy (we use 0.85 as spill threshold but the node is reporting threshold=0.7), (2) fallback selection policy prioritized smallest model by default even if not region-compatible -> mismatch and degraded latencies. I'll fetch last deploy diff.

leo: also want to check model variant compatibility table for redwood-lite-v1 vs large-v2 tokenization/kv cache expectations. If KV cache formats differ we could see cold starts and long tail latency.

rachel-ops: pulling last config change: `git log -n 5 -- routes/configs/regions.yaml` shows a commit by infra-deploy-bot 1977998000 that updated eu-west thresholds. diff below: 
```diff
- eu-west-1: capacity_watermark: 0.85
+ eu-west-1: capacity_watermark: 0.70  # accidental lower watermark
```

maria-nguyen: ok that's actionable. Mitigation plan A: roll back that config or patch watermark back to 0.85 and reload routing service. Mitigation plan B (if rollback slow): temporarily set a routing override to prefer local region for critical tenants and disable automated fallback to redwood-lite-v1 for them.

jay-khan: executing quick patch to set watermark to 0.85 on the primary routing node now. command: `kubectl exec -n infra routing-proxy-3 -- curl -XPOST http://localhost:9100/config -d '{"eu-west-1": {"capacity_watermark": 0.85}}'`

ashley-w: I'll stand up a temporary policy to avoid fallback to redwood-lite-v1 for the critical tenant list. Running policy change: `POST /v1/runtime/policies` with override.

(5m later)

maria-nguyen: patch applied. Observability: p95 in eu-west-1 dropping from 2.9s -> 1.1s on sampled requests. Spillover rate reduced from 18% -> 4%.

leo: checked model logs in eu-central-1 for requests that were routed there: the ones hitting redwood-lite-v1 have higher per-token CPU, likely due to quantization mismatch and extra decode passes. Not strictly a correctness failure but higher latency.

rachel-ops: customer impact update: Tenant-A (org-839) p95 from 1.1s -> 4.8s, 5xx peaked 5%. Tenant-B and Tenant-C saw elevated latency only (no 5xx). I'm drafting an incident note for CSMs.

jay-khan: root cause so far: accidental config change in routes/configs/regions.yaml lowered eu-west watermark -> increased spillover -> fallback policy selected a smaller model (redwood-lite-v1) which is not performance-compatible for some request patterns -> increased latency and some 5xx.

maria-nguyen: logging hypotheses in-thread for RCA tracking: [H1] config drift (confirmed by git diff) is primary. [H2] fallback policy lacks region/compatibility constraints (likely). [H3] model compatibility table missing entries for redwood-lite-v1 (investigating).

leo: marking evidence: model logs (attached), routing diffs (attached), telemetry graphs -> linking: https://internal.metrics/graphs/1978001111

ashley-w: mitigation complete and holding. I'll coordinate comms with CSMs for Tenant-A. Suggest to include SLA impact numbers and timeframe 1978001100-1978001300.

maria-nguyen: handoff to next oncall in 25m. @ashley-w will take follow-ups and finalize timeline and RCA notes. Remaining action items:
- [ ] create RCA ticket in JIRA (assign: jay-khan, leo)
- [ ] add compatibility matrix entry for redwood-lite-v1 (assign: leo)
- [ ] add a gating rule so fallback selection considers region_compatibility flag (assign: jay-khan)
- [ ] post customer-facing summary and notify CSMs (assign: ashley-w)

ashley-w: acknowledged, taking handoff. I'll update the thread with final timeline and attach traces. I'm also going to open a short-lived alert to watch spillover ratio for 2 hours.

sre-rotation-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff logged for shift swap. Next oncall: ashley-w (contact: +1-555-0101).

maria-nguyen: thanks team. Filing ticket RD-INC-1978 with initial RCA draft and linking this thread. Closing pager but keeping thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
